name: Protinex creamy vanilla
ingredients_raw: Skimmed milk powder, Maltodextrin, Soy protein isolate, Minerals (Di calcium phosphate, Ferric pyrophosphate, Zinc sulphate, Potassium iodide), Nature identical flavouring substances, Stabilizer (Guar gum), Vitamins (Choline bitartrate, Ascorbic acid, dl-alpha tocopheryl acetate, Nicotinamide, Retinyl acetate, Ergocalciferol, Thiamine hydrochloride, Calcium pantothenate, Riboflavin, Pyridoxine hydrochloride, Folic acid, d-Biotin), Sweetener (INS 955).
